name: Flags Action
description: The finding is about a `uses:` reference to this action. Nine of the scanner's audits are about action references — unpinned, stale, confusable, impostor, typosquatted, archived, superfluous, forbidden, known-vulnerable — and attaching those to the workflow file alone loses the join the question actually needs: which findings concern an action that other jobs also call. The target is the action with its ref stripped, matching how github_core keys the node; the specific pin the finding concerns rides on this edge.

property_schema.description: Which reference the finding is about. The action NODE is keyed on the path with the ref stripped (one `actions/checkout` for the whole grid), so the ref has to live here or the finding loses the pin it was reporting on.

uses.description: The `uses:` value exactly as written at the site the finding names, ref included (`actions/checkout@v4`). Carried whole rather than split into path and ref: the ref is derivable from this string, and storing both would be the same fact written twice. What the pin MEANS — its kind, whether it is immutable, what it resolved to — is github_core's `USES_ACTION` edge's fact, never re-derived here.
